criteria.text: Selecting a Story or test fills eligible interfaces it uses, including required prompt dependencies, and leaves unrelated prompt bytes unchanged.

Multiple Story, test, path and directory selections use their union, including shared dependencies once; paths work from a subdirectory. An explicit prompt file selects it and its required prompt dependencies even without tests.
An unknown or untested selection, malformed selected test, or unsafe or unavailable required dependency refuses before any hash is written, without falling back to all prompts.
With no selection, hash filling works without tests and reports each changed file. Existing current, stale, refused and warning outcomes, byte preservation, ordering and exit rules remain in force.
Compact mode still rejects operands and incompatible options before writes. Hash filling does not use authentication, network or AI.

fixture.setup: Each case uses a fresh temporary Git repository with tracked draft prompts A, B, shared and unrelated. A and B each declare shared as a required dependency; separate selected Story tests reach A and B. Capture original bytes before invocation. Use a valid draft interface in each prompt; check changed hashes with the existing hash verification helper and compare every other byte exactly.

replay_rules: Invoke the real runCheck boundary with stdout captured and gh/fetch spies; also exercise the CLI in the temporary repository. Verify exact bytes for unchanged prompts and all non-hash bytes in changed prompts. No authentication, network or AI calls.
Fixtures are expected cases, not a Runtime verdict; execute native tests after implementation. For failures assert no prompt bytes change. Retain existing status and output tests.
Treat expected_filled as set membership. Preserve the existing output group order and each result array’s existing iteration order; do not impose alphabetical order.

cases.setup: Create contracts/real-shapes.json and tracked symlink contracts/shapes.json -> real-shapes.json; set prompts/a.prompt.md result_schema to {"$contract":"contracts/shapes.json#/okResult"}.
Add tracked Story untested without its test.
Add tracked Story untested without its test.
Replace test/runtime/b.json with the invalid JSON bytes {.
Add a required Markdown dependency [missing](missing.prompt.md) to prompts/b.prompt.md; do not create prompts/missing.prompt.md.

Create and track prompts/excluded.prompt.md as a valid draft prompt. Add required Markdown dependency [excluded](excluded.prompt.md) to prompts/b.prompt.md. Create and track root pdd-workspace.json with exactly {"allowed_paths":["user_stories/","test/","prompts/a.prompt.md","prompts/b.prompt.md","prompts/shared.prompt.md","prompts/unrelated.prompt.md"]}; prompts/excluded.prompt.md exists but is outside that ceiling. Capture initial bytes after setup.
Keep B’s interface valid JSON and its existing calls and dependencies intact; change only its status value from "draft" to "invalid". Capture these modified initial bytes before invocation.
